recipes.name: Three-step first-result guide
recipes.purpose: Adapt an existing checklist to one tool setup or workshop preparation outcome.
requiredInputs: Evidence or explicitly self-reported completion for each action

sourceMap.change: Name the result and whether checks record self-report or observed evidence.

sourceMap.target: plan.tasks[].id, group, title, required, done and note
sourceMap.change: Use three stable task IDs in order. Replace all demo done states with supplied facts. Put the instruction and evidence location in note.

checks: The next required task agrees with the actual checked state
Copying or opening an instruction never proves completion
A fresh session does not inherit fictional demo completion
recipes.limits: Uses the existing checklist and next-task behavior. Does not add automatic setup detection, prompt-copy controls or a new wizard.

recipes.name: Dated lesson or practice run
recipes.purpose: Adapt the existing two-page calendar to a supplied month and short recurring practice series.
requiredInputs: Up to three short practice instructions

sourceMap.target: Page 1 month heading, Monday-to-Sunday table, A/B/C key and session-count footer
sourceMap.change: Rebuild date placement for the supplied month. Derive the planned session count from the marked dates.

sourceMap.target: Page 2 A/B/C prompt menu and reflection areas
sourceMap.change: Replace the three practice instructions. Leave outcome reflections blank until supplied.

checks: Every marked date falls in the supplied month and correct weekday column
The footer count equals scheduled entries
Scheduled activity is never described as completed participation
recipes.limits: A native document adaptation, not a scheduler or a separate interactive release board. No publishing, completion or attendance is inferred.

recipes.name: Dated evaluation and change record
recipes.purpose: Keep a short, source-backed history of template checks and revisions in the existing notebook.
requiredInputs: Criterion and observed result for each completed check
Evidence references or an explicit missing-evidence state

sourceMap.target: title, scope, revision, question, protocol and decision
sourceMap.change: Define what this record covers and what it cannot establish.

sourceMap.target: records[].id, date, title, category, status, criterion, observation, source and note
sourceMap.change: Use supplied dates and the supported passed/failed/needs-review/not-run states. Keep missing observations and sources null where appropriate.

checks: IDs are unique and every date is supported
Not-run entries have no invented observed outcome
Date filtering does not claim to reconstruct the entire system at that date
recipes.limits: A record list using existing filters and detail views. It does not implement a graph, time-travel state or automatic activity capture.
